reason: The README describes a DSH plugin, bridge, and mobile/web client whose primary user-facing purpose is remotely controlling DeepSeek Harness sessions from a phone, including pairing, session interaction, streaming output, and approvals.

summaries.zh: 通过配对的手机或网页客户端远程查看并操作 DeepSeek Harness 会话。
summaries.en: Remotely view and control DeepSeek Harness sessions from a paired mobile or web client.

capabilities: Remote mobile control of DeepSeek Harness sessions
Pairing mobile devices with a local bridge using one-time codes and device tokens
Viewing sessions and streaming execution output
Creating sessions and sending prompts, including image attachments
Approving agent requests and responding to agent questions
Forwarding a limited API allowlist from the bridge to DeepSeek Harness
